Counting labelled fixed configurations becomes the trace of a complete 64-state directed de Bruijn transfer. A common 3^{n+1} term is present exactly for 3|n. Primitivity of both 30-state blocks and strict entrywise edge deletion give 2.65923<rho_H<2.65924<2.70363<rho_L<2.70364<3 by the disclosed exact integer Collatz vectors. Trace Perron asymptotics imply ratio 1 on 3k and 0 on 3k+1,3k+2, with Life-HighLife difference asymptotic rho_L^n. Independently written direct synchronous torus census exhausts all 2^{3n} states for n=3..7, reproducing counts (127,37,91,2539,1009) for HighLife and (127,39,121,2595,1177) for Life. The finite transfer characteristic computation is exhaustively specified, not inferred from those small n.
